tasks.short: Record vehicle malfunctions and needed repairs

steps.what: Observe vehicle malfunctions and capture symptoms after reaching a safe position
Enter observations in the vehicle defect report
Check and lodge the defect report for repair follow-up

tasks.design: Use a native defect form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to capture the existing observations once and reuse them in the report. The driver checks and lodges the exact report; urgent calls, diagnosis and vehicle release remain separate human actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observed symptoms were copied from notes into a formal report.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse captured observations and vehicle identity.
tasks.still_hard: Symptoms may be intermittent and do not establish a diagnosis or roadworthiness.
tasks.human_edge: Describe what happened without guessing a repair or minimising a safety concern.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated entry with unchanged duty to report and stop when necessary.

reach.task: Prioritise inspection from a useful symptom history

evidence.claim: A native vehicle defect form can reuse entered observations; the scenario does not automate diagnosis.

assumptions: Boundary covers the durable repair record, excluding urgent dispatcher or mechanic calls in the separate notification task. Team roll-up must remove any overlap if today's defect report is itself that notification.

Driver produces vehicle ID, observation time, location, symptom text and immediate safety action in s1. Full observation and capture time remains. s2 retains manual entry for missing fields and review of reused text. No discrepancy code, diagnosis or severity flag is assumed to exist.
Test native forms before custom code. No automatic clearance to drive, no form use while driving and no saving from existing runtime.
unknowns: Whether the durable report is separate from the urgent notification
research_questions: Does single capture reduce copying after symptom checks and report review?

already_counted.description: Review reused observations and fill missing report fields

incremental.description: Maintain form and inspect failed submissions

approvals.approved_version: Exact vehicle, time, location, symptom text and safety action shown before lodgement; any edit requires a fresh check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=85; gross 15 minus upkeep 2 gives net 13. High assumes duplicated report entry; low assumes incomplete notes consume the gain. No urgent call time is saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and submit trip and operating reports

steps.what: Capture passenger counts, trips, hours, mileage, fuel and fares for reporting
Total trip details and prepare operating reports
Reconcile omissions and submit the checked report

tasks.design: Capture the existing trip tally in a native {OPS_SYSTEM} form and configure its report totals. The driver retains capture, cash reconciliation and final submission checks; telemetry can be evaluated later without assuming every shuttle has a suitable feed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trip totals were calculated and copied from a separate tally.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and report calculations can reuse captured fields.
tasks.still_hard: Missing fares, passenger-count ambiguity and exceptional journeys require driver explanation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain an unusual trip rather than accept a plausible but wrong total.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly; no change to driving or cash responsibility.

reach.learn: Trace totals to source readings and receipts

evidence.claim: Webfleet Tachograph Manager supports remote tachograph downloads and archiving; that does not establish coverage for shuttle passenger, fuel or fare fields.
Native tally reuse and arithmetic can reduce report assembly while retaining manual capture.

assumptions: Boundary covers the driver's operating report, excluding passenger service, driving and administrator processing.

Driver produces trip ID, date, vehicle ID, passenger count, start and end times, start and end odometer, fuel quantity and fare amount in s1. Full 45% capture remains; not-applicable values are explicit, not silent zeroes. Missing fields use retained receipts and manual correction in s2 or s3.
Test native reporting before custom integration. No telemetry, tachograph mandate or automated passenger feed is assumed. Existing runtime earns no saving.
No new individual performance scoring is introduced; confirm access, retention and relevant national employee consultation before rollout.
unknowns: Fields actually required and applicable vehicle rules
Native report support and cash exception frequency
research_questions: Can a native report reconcile captured trip figures without more driver corrections?

already_counted.description: Review totals and handle incomplete tally fields

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and audit failed totals

approvals.approved_version: Exact dated trip rows, mileage, hours, passenger, fuel and fare totals reconciled before submission; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=72; gross 28 less upkeep 4 gives net 24. High assumes repeated tally transcription and totals; low assumes missing receipts and corrections absorb assembly gains. Capture retains 45 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Notify dispatch or mechanics of vehicle problems

steps.what: Notify dispatchers or mechanics of vehicle problems and agree immediate safety arrangements

tasks.design: Keep the immediate call on {TELEPHONY}, made from a safe position. The driver describes the problem, confirms receipt and agrees passenger and vehicle arrangements with dispatch or maintenance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires a timely shared understanding of a live safety problem.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is assumed to replace the call.
tasks.still_hard: An alert does not prove that the right person understood the situation.
tasks.human_edge: Clarify ambiguous symptoms and urgent passenger needs in real time.
tasks.altitude: The notification conversation and decision rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify symptoms before deciding inspection arrangements

evidence.claim: A live safety notification often needs acknowledgement and clarification rather than an automated message alone.

assumptions: Boundary is the driver's immediate notification, excluding the durable defect record, mechanic diagnosis and repairs. If record and notification are one action locally, the roll-up must count that action once.

Driver supplies observed symptoms, location and passenger situation verbally in s1; all capture and clarification time remains. No structured fault or severity code is required. If the call fails, use the existing emergency or dispatch escalation procedure.
Native communication options are considered first; no new application is proposed. Zero incremental upkeep because the existing call workflow is unchanged; software runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Availability of dispatcher and maintenance contacts
research_questions: Which notifications fail to reach a responsible person promptly?

incremental.description: Unchanged communication workflow requires no added upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 with no incremental upkeep. Both routine notifications and urgent clarification remain fully human; no labour saving is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Exchange passenger service information with dispatch

steps.what: Receive passenger service requests and clarify details with dispatchers
Communicate availability, service constraints and agreed response to dispatchers

tasks.design: Retain the dispatch exchange using {TELEPHONY} or the existing approved communication channel. The driver clarifies the request and confirms a safe, feasible response without automatic task acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The live service situation determines whether a request is feasible.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement is justified from the available evidence for this conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Passenger assistance, delays and safe stopping can change what the driver can do.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when a nominally simple request conflicts with passenger needs or the current journey.
tasks.altitude: Dispatch exchanges and authority stay unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve a service conflict using the driver's current constraints

evidence.claim: A driver-dispatch exchange can require clarification of live service constraints; no automated acceptance saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is driver communication, excluding dispatcher planning, booking entry and passenger transport. Other-role planning is not transferred to the driver.

Dispatcher provides pickup, destination, service time and assistance requirements through the existing request process; its capture is unchanged outside this task. Driver clarifies missing details in s1 and supplies current constraints in s2. Both steps retain full time and need no new structured input.

Native communication options are considered before custom code. Zero incremental upkeep because no change is implemented; existing communication runtime earns no labour saving. Communications follow existing safe-driving rules.
unknowns: Frequency of incomplete or conflicting requests
research_questions: Which missing request details lead to avoidable clarification?

incremental.description: No added workflow or software upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and upkeep 0. Straightforward and difficult dispatch exchanges retain their time; no unsupported preparation baseline is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The driver keeps safe transport and live communication responsibility, with less report duplication where it exists.
reach: Help fleet maintenance understand symptoms and transport administrators trace trip totals
role.ambitious_version: Provide reliable transport records while keeping safety and passenger decisions with responsible people.
